title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC Oct 28: Fed HOLDS at 3.75–4.00% (10-2 vote; Cook+Hammack dissented for +25bp). Dec hike still priced. Warsh signals fewer 2027 meetings.
BTC ~$81K post-decision: briefly $81.7K, settled ~$80.6K. $167M crypto liquidations ($110M shorts).
GDP + PCE prints tomorrow Oct 29 — next volatility trigger.
